tei:div.tei:p: rje btsun mi la ras pa'i lo rgyus/

༈ bla ma mar pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs/ rje btsun mi la ras chen ni/ 'khrungs yul gung thang smad/ pha lnga'i nang nas ko ron/ de'i rtsa bya bar/ rigs khyung po/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang/ yum myang bza' skar rgyan gyi sras bu lcam dral gnyis 'khrungs pa'i ming po'i mtshan thos pa dga'/ sa 'brug la 'khrungs/ sring mo pe ta mgon skyid zhes bya/ chung ngu nas yab 'das/ de'i kha chems 'jog lugs nor ba dang*/ a ma dgung lo chung bas a khu'i bu'i chung ma byed dgos zer ba ma nyan pas nor rdzas thams cad a khu dang a nes bgos/ g.yog bcol shin tu khas nyen/ dang po gser g.yu'i ral pa nyil le ba la phyis shig sro'i ral pa nyil le ba zhig byung*/ der lo bcu drug lon dus kha chems kyi dan dpang rnams bos ston mo drangs/ mas da bus khyim so'ang zin 'dug pas pha nor rnams phyir sprod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams gleng bas/ a khu a ne dag za ba la kha mthun dpes har lang rgyab nas ma nyan pas/ thos pa dga' lo tsā glan chung la skra bcad yi ge 'bri klog dang phyag rdor las kyi rdo rje'i lugs dang phag mo sogs gsan/ slob dpon gyi rjes su skyid ston zhig la phyin/ mi las glu len pa dang chang gis kyang bzi nas glu len cing 'ong ba mas tshor nas/ pha mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi bu khyod 'dra ba/ nged rang ma smad kyi mkhos 'di la glu dran pa 'dug ge zer te brgyal/ sangs pa'i thabs kyis sangs nas/ a mas ci gsungs byed byas pas/ dbus gtsang du song la mthu slob la dgra thams cad kha phung la thong zer/ de nas mnga' ris stod nas dbus gtsang du mthu slob tu 'gro ba'i mi lnga tsam grogs su 'byor ba dang dgung lo bco brgyad pa la mas dpal thang sgrol ba tshun la bskyal te phebs/ lam du mthu su che rtsad bcad pas yar klung na gnyags g.yung ston khro rgyal che zer/ der byon dngos po gang yod phul nas 'di min lus ngag yid gsum yang 'bul/

bdag la pha spun skyid du 'phangs pa 'ga' yod pa la mthu mthil phyin pa zhig zhu byas pas/ kha pho che bar mdzad/ grogs lnga dang mnyam du mthu zab zab 'dra ba mang po bslab/ grogs po rnams mgu nas log song/ rje btsun ma byon pas bla mas khyod mi 'gro ba ci yin zer/ der bla ma rang gis gnang ba'i rdzong ba rnams phyag rten du yar phul nas/ ngas yul du mthu'i rtags ma thon par log na a ma nga'i mdun du lcebs nas 'chi ba yod/ mthu rtags thon pa zhig zhu byas pas/ glen pa khyod dang po nas de skad zer/ brtag pa myur ba zhig bya gsungs/ grwa pa stobs che ba mgyogs ba zhig yod pa de bden brdzun ltar btang bas/ thos pa dga' bden par 'dug zer/ 'o na gtsang rong gi lha rje ye shes gzungs dang nga gnyis blo mthun pa'i grogs po byas mthu ser brjes/ nga'i thad du mthu slob pa byung na khong can du btang/ khong gi rtsar ser ba slob pa byung na nga can du gtong bar chad byas pa yin gsungs nas 'bul chas dang yi ge mdzad de brdzangs/ khu lung du lha rje ye shes gzungs la yi ge dang 'bul chas phul nas/ sgrub khang lag mthus mi tshug pa zhig bzos/ der gshin rje dmar po gyad chen dang nag po kha thun la drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zer ba yin pas de gnang nas bsgrubs/ zhag bdun song nas bla ma byon/ sngar yin na des chog gi yod gsungs pas thag ring gi mthu lags pas rgyun bsrings dgos zhus nas yang zhag bdun du bsgrubs pas/ bla mas dam can rnams kyis mi mgo sum cu rtsa lnga dkyil 'khor gyi mthar spungs/ ngo so zla ba bzhin phyar nas byung*/ da rung bsgral bya gnyis 'dug gsungs pa/ de dag snying tshims rten du gzhog pa zhu/ da chos skyong la gtong rag thong gsungs/ de'i tshe a khu'i bu la chung ma blangs nas bag ston byed pa'i mi tshogs pa'i khyim rdib nas ma smad kyi sku dgra mi sum cu rtsa lnga shi/ a khu dang a ne lus/

'dir sgrub phur bskur nas a khu'i khang par tshad tshad kyis bslab par a mas drag tu bsnun zer pa'ang yod/ a mas gos hrul gyi rgyal mtshan phyar snying tshims bzlas so/ /der lha rje la ma gshin dang mdo sgyu sogs zhu zhing bzhugs pa'i phyi lo ma'i yi ge dang*/ mthu'i rtags byung tshul/ da dung ser ba gyang rim dgu yod pa phog zer ba dang zhing rin gser srang bdun bcas gab yig tu dbus kyi bya bral zhig la dmod btsugs nas bskur 'dug pa bla ma'i yum gyis gnang byung*/ de nas ser ba zhu ba la gnyags kyi drung du byon/ der gdong mo chu 'khyags kyi rgyud gu lang 'byung ba'i 'khrugs ser chen mo gnang nas bsgrubs pas thun dong du 'brug ldir glog g.yos/ sngar gyi grā pa de grogs su btang byung bas der ser ba gyang rim gsum yod pa phab/ ma dang 'phrad 'dod kyang khyi ra bas mthong bas bros/ kho stobs che bas yul mi dmag la bcar bcar du bsdad de snying tshims bzlas/ de nas bla ma gnyis kyi phyags phyir lo shas bzhugs/ der mi mang po bsad pa'i sdig pa yod*/ de cug byas sbyang dgos snyam yod pa dang*/ gnyags kyi yon bdag bzang po zhig na ba'i sngas srung la bla ma byon/ der phan ma thogs par kho shi bas bla ma thugs skyo nas log pheb pa'i dus/ thos pa dga' nged rang gnyis pos sdig chen po bsags yod pas/ yang na khyod kyis chos gsha' ma zhig gyis la nga 'drongs ngas rgyags skyel/ yang na ngas chos gsha' ma zhig byed nas khyod drangs/ khyod kyis 'di kun skyong nga la rgyags skyol gsungs pas skabs rnyed nas bdag gis chos bya bar nus zhus pas/ 'o na de kha gyis/ khyod na so'ang gzhon/ snying rus kyang che bar 'dug pas gsungs/ dbus kyi gos snam legs pa bsdus pa mdzo rgyab gcig stsal te gtsang rong du byon/ snubs chung mjal/ myang stod rgyad mkhar du sgyer ston dbang nge bya ba yod pas der song zhig gsungs/

der byon khong gis gdams ngag gang yod gnang*/ ngab mi byang chub rgyal po bya bar brdzangs te yang dag dang bdud rtsi dang sgyu 'phrul rnams zhus/ yar 'brog gi mar pa 'byung nge bya bar brdzangs nas ma mo sogs zhus/ gtsang rong gi 'bre ston lha dga' sar brdzangs te rdzogs chen zhus/ de yan bla ma re'i rtsar lo re tsam bzhugs/ yongs dril lo ngo bco lnga tsam rang rang gi chos la slob dpon dang mnyam par mdzad/ bskyed rim la nus pa thon kyang thugs ma tshims/ der 'bre ston gyi zhal nas/ 'o cag gnyis ngas chos bshad lo tsam/ khyod kyis nyan lo tsam 'dis mi phan/ nged rang gi 'di ka lta sgom gyi don spyi tsam las rgyud thog tu khel dka' bar 'dug /da lta lho brag chus khyer na rgya gar gyi grub thob nā ro ta pa dang mai tri pa'i dngos slob rgya gar du lo nyi shu bzhugs/ dka' ba mang du spyad pa mar pa lo tsā bya ba zhig bzhugs/ de la rdo rje'i lus la rten 'brel bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba zhig yod 'dug nged rang pha sbad der 'gro dgos par 'dug gsungs pas/ lo tsā ba'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu zing*/ mchi ma shor bas/ cis kyang 'thad zhus/ dpon slob gnyis byon/ 'brog tu bla ma bsnyun nas ma thon/ mi la phebs pas lo tsā ba'i rmang lam du nā ro pas gnang ba'i baiḍūr+ya'i rdo rje dri mas gos pa zhig byung ba bkrus te rgyal mtshan gyi rtser phyar nas 'od kyis phyogs bcu khyab pa dang*/ yum gyi rmang lam du/ nā ro pas gnang ba'i shel gyi mchod rten la dri mas gos pa khrus byas ri rtser bzhag pas kun gyis phyag mchod pa byed/ de'i dkor gnyer bud med gnyis kyis byed pa rmis/ der bsu ba la phru rlog pa'i zol gyis byon/ der mjal te kha la snang ba 'gyur yang ngo ma shes/ mjal sna bcol bas chang 'di 'thung la phru 'di rlog dang khong gis mjal sna bya'o gsungs/ dum zhig na byis pa ral ba snum tser ba zhig 'bod du byung*/

khong gis go bcad 'dug ngas kyang go chod pa byed bsam rems pas phru lhag med du rmos/ chang yang lhag med du btung bas rten 'brel 'grigs/ de nas bla ma dang mjal ba dang da gi de khar 'dug pa dang zil che bas tshom me lus pas/ khyod bden rngog gis kyang ngo ma shes/ mar pa lo tsā nga rang yin gsungs/ bdag la stod nas 'ong ba'i mi sdig po che lags pas bla mas thugs rje bzungs nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag gcig gnang bar zhus byas pas/ gdams ngag yod/ sangs rgya mi rgya khyod rang gi snying rus la rag gsungs/ nangs par nas nang mir tshud/ yum gyis byams/ de nas lho brag la kha bas bla ma'i grwa pa rnams brdung 'tshog mang du byas pas mthu rgyob gsungs pa ltar mdzad pas/ khong rnams nang 'dzings dang mi bsad mang po byung*/ bla ma la babs dgos byung bas ming mthu chen tu btags/ der sdig pa byang ba'i ched dang sras la 'bogs dgongs/ ri zur zhig tu mkhar gyi rmang zlum po zhig brtsegs/ thog so gnyis tsam longs ba na de bshig de bzhin du/ zla gam dang*/ gru gsum de rnams kyang bshig nas da lta'i sras mkhar 'di'i rmang bting*/ thog so bdun tshar ba dang khyams brtsegs su bcug de thams cad mi la rang min pa rdo lag pa tsam zhig dang sa khyem gang skyel rogs med/ de'i bar la chos gnang la re nas rngog mes mtshur sogs kyis dbang gsan pa byon pa'i zlar 'tshangs pas gral nas bton phyag 'bebs 'chi ba la gtugs pa/ dus rgyun du'ang rkyen phra mo re la bsnyad btags nas bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs mdzad de yi chad thengs bdun song gi bar la yum la'ang ma zhus/ de nas rgyab la sgal mig gsum rdol ba bstan nas chos zhu ba'i rogs la sbran pas yum spyan chab shor/ bla ma la zhus pas sgal rma rang byung med dam gsungs/ sngar rta bong la sgal rma byung ba mthong*/ mi la sgal rma byung ba thos kyang ma thos/ byung ba tsam du ma zad gsum yang rdol 'dug zhus pas khrid shog gsungs/

gzigs phul bas rma khol gyis la skyol gsungs der yang dad pa skad c-ig tsam yang ma log tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i lam bla ma gzhan la med pas bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs te mnyes par bya dgos bsam pa byung*/ der rma rnams 'grams nas na tshas ma bzod yum la zhus te re zhig ngal bsos/ rma 'grams pa zhi tsam nas mthu chen la da las gyis gsungs pas sa rdo pang du thog nas bskyal las mdzad/ khyams longs nas kyang bla mas chos ma gnang pas/ bdag med ma thugs mug nas ma bzod de yum gyis byin rlabs rten 'ga' dang phyag tham yig brdzu bskur te rngog can du brdzangs/ khong gi gra rigs dos yas pho yas mo pas brdung pas ser ba phob gsungs pa ltar phab/ rgan mo zhig la gnas tshang bcol ba de ru snying rje nas khyod kyi zhing ji lta bu yod gsungs/ 'di 'dra yod zer nas zur gsum chur rung ba zhig bris/ de ma thag sla nga bkab nas dmigs pa gtad pas mo'i zhing la ma gnod/ sla ngas ma khyab pa'i mchu chu log gis mnan/ gzhan yul de grog sul du btang*/ khong rnams rngog la bab/ de nas lam du bya byi'i ro bsdus pas steng g.yogs ltem gang ba byung*/ de bla ma'i spyan sngar dkyil 'khor gyi stegs yod pa'i khar spungs nas bshums pas ci yang mi lto jo bo nā ro ta pa'i bu rgyud la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa yod gsungs/ cung zad dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i mthar se gol gtogs pas thams cad nam mkha' la dir gyis 'phur song*/ de dag gi bya rjes byung ba stegs bu la da lta'i bar du yod do/ /rngog gis gdams ngag gnang yang bla ma'i bka' med pas myong ba ma skyes/ sras che 'don gyi dus su bla ma'i spyan sngar byon/ che 'don zin nas grwa pa byin gyis/ dbu che rags pa rnams yod pa'i dgongs shig tshogs 'khor mdzad nas der byin rnams tshogs/ dbyug pa zhig sku gzhogs su bcangs nas/

mar pa'i phyag sdigs mdzub rngog la gtad de spyan hur phyung nas/ chos rdor pa khyod ma bcol pa byed mkhan khyod mthu chen la dbang bskur gdams ngag ston pa'i rgyu ci yin gsungs pas rngog bred de/ bla ma rang gi phyag tham dang byin rten phebs zhus pas/ mthu chen la sus bskur gsungs bas bred nas yum gyis so zhus pas/ yum la phyag 'bebs gnang du chas par yum gyis sgo bcad de bzhugs pas sgo la phyag hrad hrad mdzad nas rngog la nga'i byin rten rnams da lta rang long shog gsungs/ 'byon par chas te phyir thon pa na a bo mthu chen gyis na bza' la 'jus te 'gro bar zhus pas a bo mthu chen ngas khrid rung da res kyi 'di dang 'dra/ bla mas rjes su 'dzin te 'ong*/ sbus kyis mi 'dzin na gdod bla ma la gnang ba zhus te phan gdag go gsungs pa la/ phung po nga 'dra ba/ nga rang sdug par ma zad yum dang bla ma la'ang 'di 'dra'i 'o brgyal byung*/ nga skye ba phyi mar chos dang mjal zhing thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhig shog ces lcebs par brtsam pa na bla mas de ltar mi rung ba'i tshul bshad nas bzlog /de'i ring bla ma thugs sos nas bdag med ma shog gsungs nas byon pas bla ma rngog gar song gsungs pas skabs de rnams gsol pas/ 'o na shog gyis gsungs/ mthu chen gyis kho bo drung du song na'ang bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs las med ces brgyal brgyal du bshums pas/ rngog gis khyod yar song la bla ma'i drung du mthu chen phyin chog min ltos/ bdag 'dir ma bsdad na 'dis gang min byas dogs 'dug zer/ des zhus pas/ da res 'bod pa'i mgron gyi gtso bo ni mthu chen yin gsungs pas/ bdag med mas da res khyod rang ngu mi dgos thugs rjes gting nas 'dzin nges su 'dug lab pas yum gyis sems gso yin nam bden nam the tshom me ba la drung du sleb/ der bu chen kun yang 'dzom 'dug bla ma thugs zhi bar 'dug nas/

brtags brtags na rang re kun la len pa med/ ngas ni mthu chen gyi sdig pa byang du re nas byas/ bdag med ma ni spyir bud med sems chung*/ lhag par 'di snying rje che rab 'dug pas kho la snying rje nas yig brdzus bskur/ rngog gis de la yid brten byas 'dug 'on kyang byin rten rnams tshar gcig 'dir bskur shog phyis nas khyod rang la ster gsungs/ bu slob gsar bu rnams dad pa ma log ngas 'dod pas kun nas bslang ba yin na dal bus bcol chog ste min/ bu 'di la yi chad pa dgu thong na lam lhag med du sangs rgya ba yin pa la*/ da lan 'di dang brgyad las min pas da dung dka' spyad cung zad dgos/ 'di skal ldan du shes nas phru rlog pa'i zol gyis bsus pa yin gsungs/ gral de nyid du dge bsnyen mdzad ming mnal lam bzhin du rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes gnang*/ byang sdom phog /sngags kyi dbang bskur rim pas 'ong gsungs pas/ nga'i 'di rmi lam min na rung*/ gal te rmi lam yin na sad par ma gyur cig snyam tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol/ phyi nyin nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas/ 'di mtshon byed yin/ mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor ni 'di'o zhes bar snang du bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa mjal/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha'i sprin phung tsam gyis mgrin gcig tu gsang mtshan dpal bzhad pa rdo rje zhes btags so//

dbang gong ma dngos dbang du mdzad/ dpe'i ye shes ngo 'phrod/ de nas sgyu thod gdan gsum rdo rje gur dgyes rdor yab yum rnams kyi dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa gnang*/ 'dus pa'i rim lnga dang gdan rdzogs/ dgyes rdor bsre 'pho/ mā yā'i sgyu ma sum brgyud sogs dang khyad par du phyag rgya chen po'i khrid sogs bka' babs chen po bzhi'am drug gi man ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang pa yin te/ nor zang zing gi 'bul ba ma mchis te// lus rdul du brlag pa'i zhabs phyi yis// thugs gting nas mnyes pa'i gnad ka des// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// byin rlabs can gyi bde mchog dang*// snying po ma hā mā yā dang*// dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i gsang 'dus dang*// bka' srung can gyi gdan bzhi dang*// sprul pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud// don mthar thug ston pa snying po'i skor// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// lho brag gnya' gnya'i brag la bsgom du bcug de ltar tshar bcad la lo bzhi/ rjes 'dzin la lo gnyis dang zla ba brgyad kyi ring la bzhugs/ bde mchog dgyes rdor sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po'i dkyil 'khor gzigs/ zad par sa la sogs pa'i rdzu'aphrul dang*/ grong 'jug sogs las tshan bcu gnyis grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul sogs kyi bkod pa mjal bas bla ma sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes thob/ de nas mnal lam du yul gyi khang pa zhig pa yum grongs sring mo 'khyar ba sogs byung nas yul du 'byon par 'dod pa'i gnang zhur sku mdun du phyin pas bla ma gzims nas dbu la nyi zhur phog pa/ yum gyis gsol 'dren byed pa dang stabs thug/ gtsang la yar 'gro'i glu phul bas/ khyod 'gro na btang chog mod nga gnyid pa dang thug pas slad nas mi 'phrad/ mkhar dang nga'i mgor nyi ma shar bas khyod kyi bka' brgyud ky-i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur byed/ yum gyis zas khyer bas ting nge 'dzin gyis 'tsho ba'i rtags yin gsungs te gdams ngag lhag ma rnams lhag lus med par gnang*/

sdug thug pa'i dus su 'di la ltos gsung nas shog dril la tham ma gsum gnang*/ khyod la byin dang gzhan la byin// gal te srang la bcal yod na// sum 'gyur bas kyang mi lhag ri// zhes gsungs te/ don brgyud kyi bstan pa gtad chos la'i bar skyel thung mdzad de phyag spyi bor bzhag nas smon lam dang*/ gtsang sil ma la yi la rtse na// brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod// sang nyin 'gro ba'i lam kha na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod// pha yul zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na// mi rtag sgyu ma'i slob dpon yod// a ne sring mo'i nye 'khor na// sgyu ma bshig pa'i man ngag yod// yul mi rtsis chung ba'i rang yul der// 'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod// sogs 'byung 'gyur rnams lung bstan mdzad de phebs/ rngog la phyi phyag mdzad de yul du sleb pas/ yum 'das/ sring mo 'khyar/ khang pa phal cher zhig khang zhing rnams chos skyong la 'jigs te bdag med du lus 'dug /der skyo shas gting nas langs/ a ma'i rus pa rnyed/ de la glan lo'i dbon po'i rtsar byon nas bsreg sbyangs dang sats+tsha btab/ yon du dkon brtsegs kyi pusta ka rnams phul/ zhag gcig bzhugs/ rkang tshugs phug tu bzhugs/ der a nes kha sbyang bgyis te zhing thabs kyis blangs/ rin mtshon pa sprad pa khyer nas brag dkar rta sor byon lo gsum du mi zas tsam gsol/ de nas lo drug tu zwa'i 'tsho ba la brten nas bsgoms/ de khyi ra bas mthong te mi'am 'dre gang yin ma phyed skabs/ so sgo la brtags pas thos pa dgar shes pa las 'phros te sring mo dang mdzes se gnyis kyi rtsam pa dang sha chang dum zh-ig phul te gsol bas khams 'dus kyis bsgom mi nus pa tsam byung*/ der shog dril la gzigs pas sngar rtsa nang du rlung sems 'du rgyu zas ngan pas ma slong ba des bslangs par shes de'i lugs bzhin bcos pas bogs su thon gsang gnas kyi rtsa mdud grol grub pa thob nas smin khyugs grib ma rdzong du phar 'phur tshur 'phur mdzad kyin bsgoms/

ling ba brag tu dbu ma'i mar snar me rlung tshud pas brag srin mo'i cho 'phrul dang*/ de nas brag dmar mchong lung la sogs pa byon/ lhag par la phyir byon nas lha chen po tshogs kyi bdag po dam la btags/ slob brgyud rnams kyi sbyin bdag byed par khas blangs rang srog mdangs gsol du phul/ de nas dgun de gshen rdor mo shākya gu ṇa sogs ban skye drug chos zhu bar 'ong ba'i lugs byas/ 'tsho chas nyung ngu zhig las bsnams ma byon/ khong rnams la sgang nas log byon/ de dgongs nas kha mo che babs/ zla ba lnga tsam la lam ma bye/ bu slob rnams kyis grongs yod snyam mchod 'bul byas/ de nas sos khong rnams kyis spur rus btsal du song bas/ gsa' zhig pha bong nas bya ra byed pa mthong*/ de nas dud pa dang gsung thos 'tsho chas cung zad las ma zad 'dug pas bsam gtan gyis 'tsho bar shes nas dad pa lhag par 'phel/ yul du gdan drangs/ der bsu mi rnams bro rtse bas thugs 'ur nas pha bong 'dam bzhin brdzis/ de nas mi ma yin gyi gdul bya 'ga' re btul nas mi'i 'dul bya'i thog ma ra la'i za 'og phug tu bzhugs skabs/ yul de'i phyugs rdzi rnams mdun du byung bar byis pa zhig rje btsun mthong bas snang ba 'gyur te/ chos zhur yang yang 'ong ba la/ ma dang khu bos sdang po byas phru rlog tu bcug pas chung du nas mdzes zin/ de la rje btsun gyis sgom bzlas 'dra bslab/ rgya gar du dzo ki bzhi dang 'grogs te ba la tsan+d+ra mjal phyag rdor gtum po'i skor rnams zhus te bsgoms pas nad sos lo gcig nas tshur 'khor/ de'i tshe rje btsun phug pa'i sgo brtsegs nas bzhugs/ bu chung des rje btsun gar bzhugs rtsad bcad pas/ dang po de skad zer ba zhig go /da gar song ma shes zer/ sngar gyi phug sgo brtsegs pa de bshig pas rje btsun sku khrong nge bzhugs 'dug khyod kyis don 'grub bam gsungs/ de khar bzhag dge bsnyen dang sems bskyed/

dpal bde mchog gi dbang dang bsre 'pho sogs kyi gdams pa stsal te bsgom du bcug pas bde drod 'bar ras rkyang mdzad/ thams cad kyi ras chung pa zhes bsgrags/ de nas thugs sras bu slob phal cher 'dus/ de nas chu bar du byon/ sman lung du bzhugs skabs tshe ring mas g.yos te snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag lhags te/ bar chad lung bstan gyis tshoms pa bskyed/ mi bsrun pa'i bya ba yod dgus bsam gtan gyi drod nyul du byung ba rnams gsung ngag bden pa'i tshig gis bkrol/ phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og mnan/ /rang rtags srog gi snying po bzhes/ /bka' 'bangs bgyid par gtsigs la phab// lhag par bkra shis tshe ring mas gtsos pa rnams lta ba dbu ma chen por gtan la phab/ sgom pa lam gyi rim pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad bcun/ spyod pa 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar dor phye nas bstan/ sgrub brgyud yongs kyi srung mar mnga' gsol rje btsun nyid kyi las kyi phyag rgyar bzhes/ nga yi bstan pa mi ma yin tshe ring ma/ mi dbus pa ston pa des 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ dus der mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin no/ /chu la mi bying bas zhu yas dar ma dbang phyug dang*/ khyi dang sha ba ma smad ltar dul bas khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje btul/ mtsho ma pham phyag sor gyi rtse la len pa dang*/ ti se'i rtser gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis nā ro bon chung ming sring btul/ sring mo ni bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi yum tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa de dang*/ bon chung de'i slob ma stag la me 'bar gyi sprul par bshad/ sring mo de phyag rgyar mdzad de dngas ma dbang du mdzad pas thul ba yin/ thong la'i la thog tu dam pa sangs rgyas dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran spangs rtogs mnyam par zhal gyis bzhes/ ras chung ba lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor phyi ma rnams len par brdzangs/ tshur 'khor dus ras chung ba'i nga rgyal gcog phyir/

g.yag ru che ru ma song*/ rje btsun chung du ma song bar de'i nang du 'khrul 'khor ldem ldem bzhugs pa dang*/ dpe la chags pas rkyang ma brgya bu brgya/ spyang ki ma brgya bu brgya'i 'bros ded dang*/ rje btsun rang bde dgyes gsang 'dus gdan thod mā yā drug tu bstan pa dang*/ bka' brgyud bla ma dang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ pha bong rta ltar bzhon nas rgyug pa/ chu ltar phyar ba/ 'dam ltar rdzi ba sogs sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa mdzad nas nga rgyal bcom/ bal po rdzong du/ dharma bo dhi/ shīl bha ro gnyis kyis 'dud phyag mdzad/ tshe ring ma dmar thab kyis nyams nas 'chi ba la thug snang srid kyi lha 'dre kun 'khrugs par rje btsun gdan drangs te rje mar pa dang*/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs chog mdzad de tshe bsring bar mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar dbus pa ston pa rje btsun gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis thugs rgyud bskul nas bkug /mjal dus chang bzhes 'phro de gnang bas lhag ma med par bzhes pas brgyud pa zin par dgongs/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung*// sems can kun gyi rin po che// zhes gsungs/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten te phag mo'i byin rlabs mdzad/ /phyag chen chos drug soḍa gnang*/ nga'i gtum mo a 'thung 'di sgoms shig dang song phod da tsam sems kyi ngo bo mthong bar 'gyur gsungs nas bsgom pas de kho na nyid mngon sum mthong*/ gzhan yang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga dang lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur skabs/ mi nga na so rgas pas bum pa song la dbang bskur bar gyis shig gsungs pas bum pa 'phur te/ dwags po'i mgor babs nas dbang bskur/ rim lnga bsre 'pho sogs rdzogs rim rnams kyang smin khrid du stsal/ ras chung bas rdo rje phag mo'i bris thang la rab gnas zhus pas/ ye shes pa mngon sum du byon nas bris skur thim pa dang*/ bris sku'i dbu seng byas te me tog bzhes/

mthar dgung lo gya bzhi la gshegs pa'i tshe 'di nas mngon dga'i zhing du byon nas zhing yongs su sbyang bar mdzad do zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ mya ngan las 'das nas ras chung ba ma byon gyi bar du sku spur gyis zhugs ma bzhes/ zhal chems su nga'i thab ka'i 'og na gser yod pas spur mchod gyis gsungs pas/ thab ka'i 'og g.yeng pas/ kā shi'i ras kha gang*/ gri chung rtse mos snyung 'ong ba/ ltag pas me thon pa/ sos gri 'ong ba gcig dang*/ bur dkar rdog gcig shog dril gcig 'dug pa bklags pas stod du/ bur rdog 'di dang ras 'di gri 'dis gtubs pas zad par mi 'gyur gyis sems can la ci khyed khyed kyis/ bu ram myang tshad ras la reg tshad ngan song las thar ba pa yin te/ mi la ras pa'i ting 'dzin gyi zas dang*/ reg grol gyi gos yin no/ /sems can gang gi rna bar nga'i ming thos nas dad pa de rnams skye ba bdun du ngan 'gror mi skye/ mi la ras pa la gser yod zer mi rnams kyi khar rkyag gong cig chug bya ba 'dug yi ge'i smad na/ rnal 'byor nga yi ting 'dzin zas zhes sogs 'dug gri des bur rdog dang ras grangs med du gtubs pas dang po dang che chung mnyam pa kho nar gyur/ mi kun la bkyes pas de dag mi rabs rer zad med du+u 'phel zhing myang ba dang reg pas nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing dkar chos la blo 'gyur ba kho na byung ngo*// skabs de rnams su me tog gi char sa la bab pa rnams kyang mis reg na yal 'gro zhing*/ ma yal ba rnams kyang lta bas chog mi shes pa kho na byung ngo*/ /de'i tshe ras chung ba lo ro dol gyi dgon pa na bzhugs pa na/ nam gung yol du nyams kyi snang bar chu bar na shel gyi mchod rten 'od kyis nam mkha' khengs pa gcig mkha' 'gro rnams kyis btegs nas zhing khams gzhan du drangs 'gro ba'i snang ba byung bas/ rje btsun sku gshegs par dgongs nas byon pas bong 'gros pa'i zla lam gnyis snga dro zhig gis bcad de chu bar du byon pas lam khar rje btsun dang mjal bas sku yal bar mi bden par 'dug snyam pa byung ngo*/

/spur gyi rtsar slob ma gsar pa rnams kyis ma btang bar ras chung pa yus te brgyal/ brgyal sangs pa dang spur khang nang na me rang 'bar ba de phyag gcig gis me lce mnan/ gcig gis zhal 'gram skyor te/ kho re tsho 'bag brgya pas seṅge gcig dga' ba de ras chung ba yin yar thong*/ ras chung pa yang de ltar yus mi dgos gsungs nas ras chung par rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs par mdzad do/ /snang ba dag pa'i ngor sku des mkha' spyod du gshegs/ 'bring gis shel gyi mchod rten dang seṅge la chibs nas gshegs pa dang*/ tha mas kyang spur gnyis byung ba brin dang chu bar gnyis kar bzhu ba dang gdung rus ma bzhag pa'i mthong snang sogs byung ngo*/ /de ltar rje mi la'i rnam thar 'di ni grags che ba rnams kyi lugs las sa bcad tsam zhig bsdus pa yin gyi zhi byed ri pa bya bas ma'i rnam thar mi 'dra ba brgya dang nyer bdun gzigs par gsungs pa des mdzad pa'i rnam thar mthong bar rje 'di mthar rdzogs chen gyis grub pa brnyes tshul dang*/ gter bzhes tshul sogs mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug pa rnams 'dir bkod par ma byas so// ༈¿¿slob ma'i gtso bo ras chung rdo rje grags pa ni/ gung thang du gnyan dar ma grags kyi sras su 'khrungs pas rdo rje grags su btags/ sku 'bras gtsang ba lha phrug lta bu yod yum dang khu bo 'dus pas shin tu sdang bar byung*/ klog gi zas yon gyis ma khu bskyangs/ rje mi la dang mjal ste sgom skyes/ mdze byung bas rgya gar gyi ba la tsan+d+ra la gtum po khyung sham sogs zhus/ rje mi la bsten pas ras chung par grags/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams len pa la rgya gar du mngags te byon/ ti pu pa dang mkha' 'gro grub pa'i rgyal mo/ bal po ye rang ba rnams las gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ ti pu pas rje mi la la a ga ru nag po'i phyag 'khar sogs kyi skyes bskur/ bla ma a mo gha badz+ra dang mjal/

gdams pa mang po zhus/ bod phrug snying rje ba 'dug ste khyod la zhag bdun gyi tshe las mi 'dug gsungs pa/ bla ma ti pu par zhus pas grub pa'i rgyal mo mjal bar mngags nas tshe'i gdams pa kun gnang ba yin/ 'di la jo nang rje btsun gyis bka' bkyon mdzad mod khong pas pad dkar chos 'byung legs par ma bklag pa'i gsung kho na'o// ras chung pas phal skad mkhas kyang legs sbyar mi byang bas lo tsā bas dpe la lhad bcug pa rnams bal por rnal 'byor ma zhig gis bsal/ rje btsun mi las kyang ras chung ba shel gyi mchod rten du rtag tu gzigs/ mu stegs kyi ston pa cig las phan gnod kyi man ngag mang du zhus pas de phyin rlung nag gis btums par gzigs/ bla ma la phyag lan re ba dang*/ log rtog skye ba dang*/ thugs rgyal skye ba thams cad 'di las byung*/ bla mas dpal thang nas bsus te g.yag ru'i skor dang rkyang mgur gyi skor rnams byung zhing mu stegs kyi ngan sngags rnams bsregs/ dad pa log pa rnams rdzu 'phrul mang pos btul te slar gsol ba btab pas mkha' 'gro'i chos rnams tshang bar byung ste/ dad pa lhag par skyes nas sngar lo bcu gnyis phyags phyi byas/ da dung lo bcu gnyis mi 'bral ba'i dam bca' phul/ tshe'i dbang bskur sogs man ngag rnams bla ma la yang phul/ ras chung pa dbus su byon pas/ khyod la 'jig rten pa'i khyi mo dmar mo zhig gis rkang pa nas 'dzin par 'dug go /de la zon cher gyis shig gsungs ltar/ lha lcam ldem bu'i skor gyis thugs byung ste bla ma'i drung du byon nas ring du bzhugs/ snye nam brod pa phug tu mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams tshang bar gnang*/ sum phrod du bal po a su dang mjal/ de nas gnyal lo ro'i tshe gong phug tu+u sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /

slob ma yang*/ rtsa'i rgyal ba'o/ tsang pa byas 'gol ba/ btsun chung ma/ khyung tshang pa/ 'bro sgom/ bur sgom pa/ rta shod ras pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ rje dwags po rin po che sogs so// ༈¿¿nyi ma ltar graḍa pa dpal zla 'od gzhon nu'i rnam thar ni phyi nas 'chad par bya zhing*/ skar chen lta bu ngan rdzong ston pa bodhi rā dza ni/ rje nyid kyi bka'i sdud pa po snyan brgyud rgyas pa'i bka' babs dang*/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ se ban ras pa/ khyi ra ras pa/ 'bri sgom ras pa/ ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs te thugs kyi sras brgyad dang*/ gshen sgom ras pa/ glen sgom ras pa/ rtsa phu ras pa/ mkhar chung ras pa/ rong chung ras pa/ stag sgom ras pa/ jo sgom ras pa/ dam pa rgyag phu ba/ li skor phya ru ba/ lo ston dge 'dun 'bum/ skye ston yon shāka /'dre ston bkras 'bar te nye sras bcu gsum/ mtsho lnga'i ras chung ma/ sa le 'od ma/ dpal dar 'bum/ pe ta mgon skyid rnams ni sras rnams kyi sring bzhi/ de rnams las ras chung pa/ zhi ba 'od dang*/ khyi ra ras pa/ ras chung ma/ dpal dar 'bum/ sa le 'od rnams ni sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du byon/ lcam lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron ma ni rje btsun sku bzhugs ring dpe gnyer mdzad/ de nas dpe rnams bsnams te o rgyan du gshegs pa yin no//
